# HInlineCopyText

> Compact inline clipboard actions for identifiers, hashes and endpoints.

[Start with the Hearth UI agent index](../../../llms.txt). This describes repository source for version 0.10.0. Match documentation to your installed source/release.

## Identity

- Vue export: `HInlineCopyText` from `@hearth-ui/vue`.
- Custom element: `<hearth-inline-copy-text>`.
- Constructor: `HearthInlineCopyTextElement` from `@hearth-ui/elements`.
- Category: Developer.
- [Implementation](https://github.com/samishal1998/hearth-ui/blob/main/src/components/HInlineCopyText.vue).

## Choose and use it correctly

- Display may be abbreviated while value remains the exact clipboard payload. A native button and stable polite status announce success or failure. Use HCopyField when a full read-only input is appropriate. Clipboard access requires a secure context or the existing fallback.

## Public API

value, label, display: string · disabled, truncate: boolean

A `?` marks optional source props. Props with defaults may be omitted. Internal `formDisabled` and `control-sync` plumbing is excluded below; do not use it in application code.

```ts
type Props = {
    value: string;
    label?: string;
    display?: string;
    disabled?: boolean;
    truncate?: boolean;
};
```

### Defaults

```ts
{ label: "value", truncate: true }
```

### Events

copied(), copy-error(string)

```ts
type Emits = {
    copied: [
    ];
    "copy-error": [
        message: string
    ];
};
```

Vue-emitted custom-element events expose argument arrays in `event.detail`. Listen on the element. Native events such as `click` retain their normal payloads. The elements package provides framework-independent DOM event types.

### Slots

None

Vue uses `<template #slotName>`; custom elements use `<div slot="slotName">`. Web components do not support Vue scoped slots.

### CSS parts

base, control, value

Use `hearth-inline-copy-text::part(part-name)` for an exposed part or inherited `--h-*` tokens for shared styling. Native Vue components use the shared stylesheet and `h-*` classes.

## Vue example

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { HInlineCopyText } from '@hearth-ui/vue';
import '@hearth-ui/vue/styles.css';

</script>

<template>
  <HInlineCopyText value="req_7c9a31f084b2" display="req_7c9a…84b2" label="request ID" />
</template>
```

## Web-component example

Provide a mount point. For field submission, use an owning native form; the auth page already contains its own form.

```html
<div id="example"></div>
```

This is bundler-based ESM. For raw HTML, load `dist/themes.css` with a link and import `registerElements` from `./dist/elements/index.js` instead. Initial array/object properties are assigned before connection to establish reset defaults.

```js
import { registerElements } from '@hearth-ui/elements';
import '@hearth-ui/elements/themes.css';
registerElements();

const mount = document.querySelector('#example');
const element = document.createElement('hearth-inline-copy-text');
Object.assign(element, {
  "value": "req_7c9a31f084b2",
  "display": "req_7c9a…84b2",
  "label": "request ID"
});

element.addEventListener('copied', event => {
  const [value] = event.detail;
  // Update your application state using value.
});

mount.append(element);
```

- [HCodeBlock](../code-block/llms.txt): Escaped, copyable code or configuration text with optional wrapping and line numbers.
